name: mem-setup
description: > This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.
author: thedotmack
summary_zh: 用于配置 claude-mem 在 Cowork 中的连接凭据，适合首次接入云端同步或绑定 cmem.ai 账号时使用。
